title: Genetic reanalysis assisted by o3 contributes to 18 diagnoses
summary: Among 376 unresolved cases, o3 Deep Research proposed explanations reviewed by specialists: 18 diagnoses were clinically confirmed, seven of which had already been established elsewhere but were missing from local records. This was a retrospective study across heterogeneous cohorts, without a measure of time saved or effect on care; clinicians made the decisions.
organization: OpenAI, Boston Children’s Hospital, and Harvard University

evidence.tested: Retrospective multicohort reanalysis of 376 unresolved cases; a diagnosis required a pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant confirmed in a CLIA-certified lab and returned to families, and seven rediscoveries were also reported.
evidence.unknown: The abstract states that the retrospective design motivates prospective multicenter evaluation with predefined endpoints, calibration reporting and comparator baselines.
evidence.ai_role: An LLM ingested clinician notes, HPO terms and a filtered variant table and proposed candidate hypotheses for expert adjudication under ACMG/AMP criteria; experts made the classifications.
